analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 26.2 entering oversold territory, continuing downtrend from 30.6 five days ago. MACD histogram improving to -0.2719 but still negative. ADX at 32.8 shows a clear trend, with -DI at 34.4 dominating +DI at 9.5. Current price $53.40 is a slight rebound from the 5-day low of $53.37, indicating potential for a Higher Low pattern. Approaching the lower Bollinger Band at $53.19. Volume ratio at 1.44, adding conviction to the move. 4-hour RSI at 28.4, also in oversold territory.
